claims.disproof_condition: 條件：PCB 板廠（客戶端）的一手寫出 AI 板的背鑽／鑽孔設備需求放緩、延後或取消擴產；或大量科技月營收年增連續三個月轉負而 AI 伺服器／交換器板出貨仍在增加。核查頻率：每月（大量月營收）＋每季（板廠法說、重訊、投資者關係紀錄）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀鑽孔設備層讀圖的需求段。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Ta Liang Technology annual report FY2025): AI server mainboards commonly have 28–36 layers (some above 50) and require back-drill depth control finer than 0.15 mm, which drives demand for high-end drilling and measurement equipment; back-drill process demand has risen sharply, hole counts have increased markedly and existing (inner-copper depth measurement) equipment capacity can no longer keep up with customers' process load. Self-reported by an equipment supplier; no customer or third-party source is named.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：大量下一份年報或季報的營收、營業比重或客戶集中度與此不符；或板廠擴產計畫普遍延後、大量月營收連續三個月年減。核查頻率：每月（月營收）＋每季（財報）＋每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim，重讀鑽孔設備層讀圖的需求段與客戶段。
claims.statement: Ta Liang Technology reports FY2025 revenue of NT$5.078 billion and profit of NT$716 million, both record highs; equipment was 96.01% of revenue (PCB and semiconductor equipment are not split); no customer exceeded 10% of sales in 2024 or 2025, and customers buy its high-priced machines according to annual capacity-expansion and replacement plans, so revenue follows customers' capex. Its Nanjing subsidiary's new plant was completed and in production by end-2025. Revenue and mix are time-varying self-reported figures.
